comment: The page taxonomy the pipeline names pages in: label_space is the page-axes model's label space (the trainer's taxonomy file); page_type_overrides, family_map, L2_merge, L3_merge and context_rules come from the rules taxonomy, name_map from the training name map. Copied by `python -m stages.lib.page_classify.canon_convert --refresh-taxonomy`; legacy_L1, legacy_L3 and placements are that script's hand tables. canon_convert reads the tables to put page_canon.json in these names; the pipeline reads label_space (page_classify/taxonomy.py) and codeability (the tag of each L1 > L2 and L1 > L2 > L3, which the Final codability reads).

L2.Progress Note > Lab Results: Progress Note > Lab and Imaging Results

page_essence.rule: Each page is labelled by what the page itself holds, because the model sees one page at a time. A page that is wholly lab results, imaging results, a medication list or an order list takes that standalone path (Lab Report, Medication Record, Order and Requisition) even when it sits inside a progress note, discharge packet or other document. Headers, footers, signature or routing blocks, an allergy list or a short problem list on the same page do not change this.
page_essence.split_pages: A page that also carries note content (HPI, interval history, ROS, exam, assessment, impression or plan) is a split page and keeps the parent document's path, with the L2 that fits the page (for example Progress Note > Lab and Imaging Results or Medication List).
page_essence.grouping: Grouping pages back into documents is done later, outside the page classifier.
page_essence.comment: Client direction 2026-10-24. Replaces the earlier parent-document rule for lab, medication and imaging pages.

clinical_summary.decided_by: the TITLE of the document, never by a phrase inside a note
summary_of_care_titles: Encounter Summary (C-CDA export with OID header such as 2.16.840.1.113883 / 2.840.114350)
clinical_summary.pages_inside: Every page of the summary takes this path, including the problem, medication, lab and note sections printed inside it (same parent-document rule as labs inside a progress note).
clinical_summary.stays_progress_note: An authored provider note that MENTIONS a summary ("After Visit Summary (Snapshot) printed", "Summary of care document sent to") is still a Progress Note. An Epic encounter print whose pages are the provider note stays Progress Note.
clinical_summary.stays_discharge_summary: A hospital discharge packet page titled Clinical Summary (Result Type Clinical Summary inside Discharge Documentation) stays Discharge Summary. Anesthesia Transfer of Care notes and true facility-to-facility transfer forms stay Discharge Summary > Transfer of Care.
clinical_summary.codeability: non_codeable: a summary export restates encounters; code from the authenticated source note
clinical_summary.encounter_type: no page-type prior: the setting comes from wording on the page (admit date, visit type), so an outpatient summary is no longer pushed to Inpatient
clinical_summary.comment: Client approved 2026-10-24 after Charts 8-11. Cross-validated by chart: Progress Note F1 0.817 -> 0.819 with the new class, so it does not take pages from Progress Note; the text model alone confuses Clinical Summary with Progress Note, so the title rule is what decides it.

admission_history_and_physical.when_encounter: hospital stay: inpatient, observation or short stay. Evidence on the page or in the chart: Adm Date / Date of admission, Admitting or Attending physician, Room/Bed, an observation or inpatient service, or a discharge document in the same chart.
admission_history_and_physical.pages_inside: Every page of the admission H&P takes this path, including medication, lab or imaging pages bound inside it (same rule as lab/medication pages inside a progress note).
admission_history_and_physical.otherwise: An office or clinic H&P (pre-operative clearance in a clinic, initial OB visit, new-patient H&P) stays Progress Note with its section-based L2. An "H&P reviewed, no changes" update before a procedure stays where it is (Operative Note > Pre-operative when it sits in the operative record).
admission_history_and_physical.comment: Client direction 2026-10-24: the admission H&P belongs with the hospital-stay documents under Discharge Summary, next to Interim Summary, Transfer of Care and Short Stay Summary.

inpatient_consultation.when_encounter: hospital stay: inpatient, observation or short stay (same evidence as admission_history_and_physical)
inpatient_consultation.otherwise: An outpatient consult visit stays Progress Note; a consult letter to the referring doctor is Provider Letter > Consultation Letter.
inpatient_consultation.comment: Client approved 2026-10-24: an inpatient consult belongs to the stay, like the admission H&P.

telephone_encounter.otherwise: A scheduled telephone or video VISIT with history, assessment and plan is a Progress Note (encounter type Outpatient (Evisit)), not a Telephone Encounter.

superbill.when: an encounter form or superbill: visit date, provider, diagnosis codes (ICD-10) and service codes (CPT/HCPCS), often with fee columns
superbill.not: an invoice, patient statement, cost estimate or payment receipt (Billing & Invoices)
superbill.comment: Client direction 2026-10-24: Superbill is its own type; more examples to come.

records_request.when: any page whose purpose is requesting medical records: a provider or payer request letter, a records-request fax, or an EHR addendum or note documenting a records request
records_request.comment: Client direction 2026-10-24: defined by purpose, not by form.
